summary: Architectural implementation plan for Q'mem Baltna (ቅመም ባልትና) - an authentic Habesha export-standard spice and food storefront. Includes luxury heritage visual direction, bilingual English/Amharic support, live ETB/USD currency toggle, 4 export-grade products with weight options (500g/1kg), slide-over shopping bag, dynamic checkout modal supporting Telebirr, Chapa/Stripe, Bank Transfer, and Cash on Delivery, unique order confirmation, story & craftsmanship showcase, customer feedback, and contact inquiries.
